verdict.rationale: Inngest ships a documented REST API (events, function runs, environments) and a CLI that can inspect runs, fetch traces, and invoke functions, giving reasonable programmatic coverage of core operational tasks. However, there's no evidence of an OpenAPI spec (docs.md and openapi.json probes both 404) and no explicit claim that UI-only surfaces like AI Overview or Agent Evals dashboards are fully API-accessible, so full UI/API parity is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: OpenAPI/spec discoverability, explicit parity statement covering dashboard-specific features (AI Overview, Agent Evals, session management), and independent confirmation that API can replicate every UI action.
